description.value: McDonald's is a well-known fast food chain with a single-storey location on Clarke Road in central Coquitlam, offering burgers, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages. The restaurant supports drive-through, curbside, and mobile app ordering, making it easy to grab food without locking up a loaded bike. As a nationally consistent chain with broad menu options and multiple payment methods, it is a familiar and reliable meal stop for cyclists passing through the area.
